collapse_trap_note: 20 (satellite, leg) pairs whose rendered discriminator is ONE value across every view and row that carries it. The previous profile listed 10; all 10 are inside this 20. The extra 10 are legs derived from a source COLUMN that happens to be constant because only one view carries the leg - a weaker signal than a literal constant, but the consequence is the same: the leg cannot separate the instances it is the discriminator for. IDENTICAL at the baseline snapshot, so this is a detector widening, not a bundle change. The spec builder must assert no key expression references any of the 20.
renumbering_ordinal_note: SEVEN SPELLINGS, re-enumerated THIS RUN BY SHAPE over all 1544 source column names in 00_tables_index.json plus the map, never by lookup and never by a naming convention this build happens to use. Note SERIAL_NO, SRL_NO and SR_NUMBER are three spellings of ONE concept, and RISK_SERIAL_NO / RISK_SERIAL_NUMBER are two more of another -- BUILD_RULES 5.2's named hazard, present here. VOCABULARY CALIBRATION RECORDED: my first pass admitted a bare _NO suffix and returned 37 names including MOBILE_NO, PAN_NO, AADHAR_NO and FLIGHT_NO, which are IDENTIFIERS, not positional counters. A gate that fires on those gets switched off and then protects nothing (BUILD_RULES 1.12). The tightened vocabulary -- SR / SRL / SERIAL / SEQ / SEQUENCE / SNO / ORDINAL / LINE / ROW / IDX / INDEX / POSITION, optionally suffixed -- returns exactly 7 and is the one reported.

build_directives.directive_note: 787 of 5496 arrows skip 1 to 4 levels; every intervening view must be expanded into the join chain.

build_directives.directive_note: A link leg must be byte-identical to the key of the hub it references; a disagreeing leg produces an empty join, which reads as sparse source data rather than an error.
build_directives.mechanism: 25 of 51 LNK call sites are POSITIONAL and 11 have a single leg, so leg identity CANNOT be recovered from a name on those. Match each leg's expression STRING against the set of hub key expressions resolved on the same view (BUILD_RULES.md 4). Assert every LNK leg string appears verbatim as some hub's resolved_key.expression on that view; raise on any that does not.
